  [hG : MeasurableSpace G] [inst_1 : MeasurableSingletonClass G] {Ω₀₁ : Type u_2} {Ω₀₂ : Type u_3}
  [inst_2 : MeasureSpace Ω₀₁] [inst_3 : MeasureSpace Ω₀₂] (p : refPackage Ω₀₁ Ω₀₂ G) {Ω : Type u_4}
  [inst_4 : MeasureSpace Ω] [inst_5 : IsProbabilityMeasure ℙ] (X₁ X₂ X₁' X₂' : Ω → G) (hX₁ : Measurable X₁)
  (hX₂ : Measurable X₂) (hX₁' : Measurable X₁') (hX₂' : Measurable X₂') (h₁ : IdentDistrib X₁ X₁' ℙ ℙ)
  (h₂ : IdentDistrib X₂ X₂' ℙ ℙ) (h_indep : iIndepFun (fun _i => hG) ![X₁, X₂, X₂', X₁'] ℙ)
  (h_min : tau_minimizes p X₁ X₂) [inst_6 : IsProbabilityMeasure ℙ] [inst_7 : IsProbabilityMeasure ℙ] :
  let D := d[X₁ + X₂' # X₂ + X₁'];
  let Dcc := d[X₁ | X₁ + X₂' # X₂ | X₂ + X₁'];
  let D1 := d[p.X₀₁ # X₁];
  let Dc1 := d[p.X₀₁ # X₁ | X₁ + X₂'];
  let D2 := d[p.X₀₂ # X₂];
  let Dc2 := d[p.X₀₂ # X₂ | X₂ + X₁'];
  D + Dcc + I₁ = 2 * k →
    Dcc ≥ k - p.η * (Dc1 - D1) - p.η * (Dc2 - D2) →
      Dc1 - D1 ≤ k / 2 + H[X₁] / 4 - H[X₂] / 4 →
        Dc2 - D2 ≤ k / 2 + H[X₂] / 4 - H[X₁] / 4 →
          H[X₁ + X₂ + X₁' + X₂'] - H[X₁ + X₂'] / 2 - H[X₂ + X₁'] / 2 + I₁ ≤ (1 + p.η) * k →
            H[X₁ + X₂' - (X₂ + X₁')] = H[X₁ + X₂' + (X₂ + X₁')] →
              X₁ + X₂' + (X₂ + X₁') = X₁ + X₂ + X₁' + X₂' →
                IndepFun (X₁ + X₂') (X₂ + X₁') ℙ →
                  D = H[X₁ + X₂' - (X₂ + X₁')] - H[X₁ + X₂'] / 2 - H[X₂ + X₁'] / 2 →
                    H[X₁ + X₂ + X₁' + X₂'] ≤ H[X₁ + X₂'] / 2 + H[X₂ + X₁'] / 2 + (1 + p.η) * k - I₁ →
                      H[X₁ + X₂'] = k + H[X₁] / 2 + H[X₂] / 2 →
                        H[X₁] = H[X₁'] →
                          k = H[X₁' - X₂] - H[X₁'] / 2 - H[X₂] / 2 →
                            H[X₁' - X₂] = H[X₁' - X₂] - H[X₁] / 2 - H[X₂] / 2 + H[X₁] / 2 + H[X₂] / 2 := sorry
